name: @mytask/api-contract
description: MyTask.ge API contract sources (OpenAPI 3.1). Only the solution-architect edits src/. openapi.yaml is generated.

scripts.lint: npm run build:root && redocly lint src/openapi.root.yaml --config redocly.yaml
scripts.bundle: npm run build:root && redocly bundle src/openapi.root.yaml --config redocly.yaml -o openapi.yaml && node scripts/stamp-bundle.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run bundle && npm run lint:bundle && npm run check:contract && npm run check:coverage
scripts.verify:final: npm run lint && npm run bundle && npm run lint:bundle && node scripts/check-contract.mjs openapi.yaml --final && node scripts/check-coverage.mjs --final --markdown coverage/SUMMARY.md
